description: Sensor expectations for the dynamic-rule tests (P Part 0.3): T-DYN-2 load-dependent channels and T-DYN-3 perturbation signs from a trimmed cruise point. Noise is in configs/physics/defaults.json sensors.

load_dependent.ref: channels that must follow a throttle/altitude sweep. Excluded on purpose: coolant_t (thermostat-regulated), bus_v and fuel/rail pressure (regulated; a load-dependent common-rail pressure map is a known model gap)

cruise_trim.ref: generic cruise point for T-DYN-3 (tas null = installation design airspeed); below the overspeed cut on every engine

sensitivity.ref: expected signs from first principles: more throttle -> more air/fuel/heat; warmer air -> less dense charge, less power, hotter engine; more airspeed -> more cooling air; altitude -> less power on a naturally aspirated engine (turbo and diesels hold power below their critical altitude, so no sign is declared); humid air -> water vapour displaces oxygen, less power (spark ignition at fixed lambda). Prop rpm setpoint +100 is not declared yet: the governor has no setpoint lever (M5 mission levers).
